name: Create an OVHcloud server
description: Create a server in this OVHcloud project.

id.label: Cloud project
id.description: Cloud project in which the server will be created.

name.label: Server name
name.description: Name assigned to the new server.
name.help: Use a name that clearly identifies the server.

region_id.label: Region
region_id.description: Cloud region in which the server will be created.
region_id.help: Select a region available in the synchronized provider catalog.

availability_zone_id.label: Availability zone
availability_zone_id.description: Availability zone in which the server will be created.
availability_zone_id.help: Leave empty to let OVHcloud select an availability zone.

flavor.label: Server flavor
flavor.description: Compute and memory configuration of the server.
flavor.help: Select a flavor available in the chosen region.

image.label: Operating system image
image.description: Operating system image installed on the server.
image.help: Select an image available in the chosen region.

billing_period.label: Billing period
billing_period.description: Billing frequency applied to the server.
billing_period.help: Select hourly billing for flexibility or monthly billing for a monthly commitment.

backup_server_id.label: Backup server
backup_server_id.description: k2 server whose private IPv4 address will be used as the backup host.
backup_server_id.help: Leave empty to use the first k2 server in this cloud project.
